description: IoT-deNAT: Outbound flow-based network traffic data of IoT and non-IoT devices behind a home NAT is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Yair Meidan, Vinay Sachidananda (Ben-Gurion University of the Negev). This dataset is comprised of NetFlow records, which capture the outbound network traffic of 8 commercial IoT devices and 5 non-IoT devices, collected during a period of 37 days in a lab at Ben-Gurion University of The Negev. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is restricted according to the metadata; the conditions were not read. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
